landing.awarenessTitle: [日本語] Why Carbon Footprint Monitoring Matters
landing.awarenessDesc1: [日本語] Human activities generate greenhouse gases that accelerate global climate change. Every commute, electricity bill, dietary choice, and retail purchase carries a hidden carbon cost.
landing.awarenessDesc2: [日本語] By establishing a clear baseline and measuring daily outputs, individuals and organizations can target impactful reductions, unlock financial savings, and drive meaningful environmental stewardship.
